🎭 Premiere at Ilkhom!
A new production, "Night Tram": the story of a city that never sleeps. Music by a live orchestra.

📅 Saturday, 10 October, 19:00
🎟 Tickets at the theatre box office. 16+
This Sunday at 11:00 there's an origami workshop for kids in the Japanese Garden! 🦢 For children aged 6 and up, with their parents. Free entry, we bring the paper and scissors.
Jazz night this Friday 🎷 The Silk Road Trio plays two sets at Bootlegger from 8 pm, open jam after 10. Free entry, book a table via DM.

Weekend programme at Tashkent City Park 🍂

Saturday
12:00 — crafts and farmers' market
18:30 — open-air concert "Autumn Lights"

Sunday
09:00 — 5 km run, on-site registration from 8:00

Free entry to all events.
Tomorrow Yunusabad hosts the Kazan Fest plov festival: 20 kazans from cooks all over the country, masterclasses and live music. From 10:00 to 16:00, landmark: Yunusobod metro station.
Board game night this Friday from 19:00! Mafia, Carcassonne, Codenames and tea. We'll confirm the venue closer to the date, watch the channel 🎲
We're looking for volunteers for the autumn festival team! We need photographers, coordinators and people in a good mood. Sign-up form via the link in the channel profile.
Thanks to everyone who came to the quiz at Cavern club yesterday! 🏆 The winner was team "Samsa, Hold the Onions". Next game: 23 October at 19:30, same place. Register in the bot.
Save the date: the Autumn Book Fair opens at the National Library on 20 November, 10:00–18:00. Publishers from across Central Asia, readings and signings.
